description: This Java source file defines a helper class for managing fixed deposit products within integration tests for the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods to build product JSON payloads, configure charts, and interact with the API endpoints to create and retrieve fixed deposit products and interest rate charts. The class encapsulates product configuration like interest calculation, deposit terms, and accounting rules, primarily aiding automated testing of fixed deposit functionalities.

classes.name: FixedDepositProductHelper
classes.description: A helper class for constructing, configuring, and interacting with fixed deposit product API resources in integration testing contexts.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a JSON payload for creating a fixed deposit product with specified validity dates, optionally including interest charts.

methods.name: constructChartSlabWithPeriodRange
methods.description: Creates a sample interest chart slabs configured with specific period ranges.

methods.name: constructChartSlabWithPeriodAndAmountRange
methods.description: Creates interest chart slabs with combined period and amount ranges.

methods.name: constructChartSlabWithAmountRange
methods.description: Creates interest chart slabs based solely on amount ranges.

methods.name: withAccountingRuleAsNone
methods.description: Configures the fixed deposit product to use 'None' as its accounting rule.

methods.name: withAccountingRuleAsCashBased
methods.description: Configures the product to use 'Cash Based' accounting rule with provided account mappings.

methods.name: withAccountingRuleAsAccrual
methods.description: Configures the product to use 'Accrual' accounting rule with provided account mappings.

methods.name: withPeriodRangeChart
methods.description: Sets up interest charts with period range slabs.

methods.name: withPeriodAndAmountRangeChart
methods.description: Sets up interest charts with combined period and amount range slabs.

methods.name: withAmountRangeChart
methods.description: Sets up interest charts with amount range slabs.

methods.name: withAmountAndPeriodRangeChart
methods.description: Sets up interest charts with combined amount and period range slabs.

methods.name: withWithHoldTax
methods.description: Enables tax withholding with specified tax group ID.

methods.name: getAccountMappingForCashBased
methods.description: Returns account mapping for cash-based accounting rule based on provided account list.

methods.name: getAccountMappingForAccrualBased
methods.description: Returns account mapping for accrual-based accounting rule based on provided account list.

methods.name: createFixedDepositProduct
methods.description: Performs HTTP POST request to create a fixed deposit product using provided JSON payload.

methods.name: retrieveAllFixedDepositProducts
methods.description: Performs HTTP GET request to retrieve all fixed deposit products.

methods.name: retrieveFixedDepositProductById
methods.description: Performs HTTP GET request to retrieve details of a fixed deposit product by its ID.

methods.name: getInterestRateChartSlabsByProductId
methods.description: Fetches interest rate chart slabs associated with a specific product ID.
